preflight.estimateMethod: Actual adapter-shaped JSON body: UTF-8 bytes charged as input tokens, plus 4096 tokens per request for framing; maximum 8192 output tokens reserved for every extension request. limitations: No live model quality result is established by this preflight.
Hosted review API returns hydrated candidates, room state and bounded numeric provider counters when available; not raw Meta response envelopes or billed charges.
Local source snapshot hashes establish evaluator identity; they do not remotely attest deployed source.
Structured-rule equivalence and exact-source preservation are tested. Full quality of generated translations is not automatically scored.
preflight.executionGate: Wait for root/operator explicit live execution after payment, key setup and server enablement. This agent has no authorization to execute network requests.

evidenceScope: API calls to the owned hosted test site. Alice/Bob are simulated editors. Raw responses are own-site API responses containing hydrated rules, not raw Meta transport payloads. Corpus expected decisions are separate from model output.
usageLimitation: Review POST attempts are durably counted before dispatch. Bounded provider token counters and durations are retained when returned; billed cost is not measured. Observed room modelCallCount is an app counter, not a billing receipt. No retries or search.
